name: lab-ui
source: Generated from per-block block.json files. Do not edit block lists in gallery.html by hand.

blocks.title: Header · corporate reference
blocks.description: Reference header imported from the Corporate Landing CMS template with nested menu and locale fragments expanded for comparison with the lab-ui canonical header.

blocks.title: Header · canonical (multi-level)
blocks.description: Canonical light-theme the platform header. Uses the live example.com header proportions and compact mobile reveal behavior, while extending the nav contract to support link, dropdown, and mega items. Panels open on hover + focus-within on desktop; below 1024px the burger reveals a full-width menu with nested panel links shown inline as indented subitems. Composes cta.btn-primary-ring + language.locale-dropdown. Owns the optional floating breadcrumb chip for non-root pages.

blocks.title: Footer · corporate reference
blocks.description: Reference footer imported from the Corporate Landing CMS template with its nested footer fragments expanded into one lab-ui block.

blocks.title: Footer · canonical
blocks.description: Dark site footer used across example.com and all the platform landings. 3-column grid: brand+tagline+address / 5-link nav / socials+emails. Bottom row: copyright + legal links. Used regardless of page theme (light/dark) — the footer itself is always dark.

blocks.title: CTA · button geometry base
blocks.description: Shared geometry and .btn-star base for every CTA variant. Defines .btn (pill shape, height 3.25rem, padding, transition) and .btn-star (icon flex + rotation transition). Variant blocks (cta.btn-primary-ring, cta.btn-secondary-filled) extend this base.

blocks.title: Primary CTA · rainbow ring pill
blocks.description: Pill button with a 1.5 px rainbow gradient ring (cyan → orange → magenta, 249.99deg base, flips to 264.85deg on hover) and a sparkle star icon that rotates 180° on hover. The outer hover glow is tinted by the current vertical's --cta-accent token (cyan default; lorem-green → green; lorem-orange → orange; etc). Uses the same tight bottom-centered radial hover glow as cta.btn-secondary-filled.

blocks.title: Secondary CTA · filled pill (vertical-themed)
blocks.description: Secondary CTA paired with primary. Fully filled pill — background is a 90° dark gradient that re-themes per vertical via --cta-secondary-fill (lorem-cyan: bronze/olive; lorem-green: dark green; lorem-orange: dark amber; etc). Light text, 1 px soft border, always-on soft halo that strengthens on hover, sparkle icon that rotates 180° on hover. Inner bottom hover-rise comes from effect.hover-rise. No rainbow ring — explicitly a different visual primitive than primary so the pair reads as two distinct affordances.

blocks.title: Locale selector · dropdown
blocks.description: Pill button with chevron-down + current language label on desktop. On mobile it compacts to a two-letter locale code and code-only dropdown. Hydrates from /core/api/language/active.json on a real server; falls back to en/fr/es when offline (file:// or no API).

blocks.title: Hero · composite photo (vertical-landing)
blocks.description: Hero for vertical-landings (Lorem Ipsum, Lorem Ipsum, Lorem Ipsum, etc). Left column: breadcrumb eyebrow, 3-line H1 with italic-blue accent, 2 lede paragraphs, CTA pair. Right column: 5:6 photo slot with overlays — dark stat chip (bottom-left) and two person cards (top-right). Photo defaults to a neutral striped media placeholder; replace via {{photo_url}} (IMAGE param).

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width vertical hero background; separate from the main photo slot.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Hero · operational hub
blocks.description: Signature hub hero. Left column: breadcrumb-style eyebrow, three-line H1 with italic-cyan accent on the middle word, three lede paragraphs, primary + secondary CTA pair. Right column: neutral rectangular product screenshot placeholder. Light theme adaptation of v5 hero variant B (designer default).

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width hero section background; separate from the product screenshot slot.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Features · 2-col numbered accordion
blocks.description: Two independent accordion columns of feature rows. Each row carries a monospace F.NN badge, a title, and a plus-icon toggle that rotates 45° and inverts on open. Multiple rows can be open at the same time (matches v5 design source — no one-open rule). 20 slot capacity (15 wired here, easy to extend); empty slots auto-hide via block.js.

blocks.title: Features · 3-card horizontal grid
blocks.description: H2 + 3 lede paragraphs + 3 horizontal cards. Each card carries a mono number badge, a title, and two body paragraphs. Used as the 'Connected Operations' / 'How the platform Works' framing pattern. 3 fixed slots (use features.accordion-2col-numbered for variable counts).

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width features section background.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Features · 4-card horizontal grid
blocks.description: H2 + 3 lede paragraphs + 4 horizontal cards. Each card carries a mono number badge, a title, and two body paragraphs. Used as the 'Unified Platform' / 'What's Inside' framing pattern. 4 fixed slots; collapses to 2 columns at ≤1180px, single column at ≤720px.

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width features section background.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Comparison · the platform matrix
blocks.description: ServiceWand-style comparison matrix with 2-6 product columns, per-cell icon status parameters, a highlighted primary column, and stacked mobile cards below 860px.

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width comparison section background; gradient mode preferred over image because the table already has strong surface styling.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Comparison · two-col SEO matrix
blocks.description: Two-column SEO comparison matrix with a criteria column, highlighted ServiceWand column, competitor column, the standard ServiceWand wordmark logo in the H2 title (title param is the text after the logo), H3 column headings, H4 row headings, and mobile card layout.

blocks.title: FAQ · bubble light grouped
blocks.description: FAQ section organized into 4 categories x 7 questions (28 slots). Each question is an H3 inside a rounded bubble that expands using native <details>. Group labels are non-heading text. First question in each group ships open.

blocks.title: Section · Axes grid (multi-axis from→to)
blocks.description: Standard section header plus multi-axis matrix of scaling dimensions. Up to 6 axes (cards with auto-hide for empty slots). Each axis: H3 label, a full-width tick track (7 ticks with opacity ramp suggesting growth), and from-to range labels in mono. 3-col grid -> 2-col at <=980 -> 1-col at <=640. Used for sections after StagesList.

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width narrative section background.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Section · H2 narrative
blocks.description: Two-column narrative section: left eyebrow + H2 + 3 paragraphs and right H2 + 3 paragraphs. Used as the framing pattern for soft sections (AI / SMB / Scalable / Operational philosophy) where the message is the visual.

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width narrative section background.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Section · Stages list (growth ladder, 01→04)
blocks.description: Standard section header plus vertical growth ladder with 4 stages (01-04). Each stage has a left rail with stage eyebrow, big number, and a 4-tick progression scale. Main area: title + lead + additive capability chips with plus prefix.

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width growth/stages section background.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Section · Stats strip (KPI metrics row)
blocks.description: 4-cell KPI metrics row. Each cell: large display-typed number + mono label + short body. Cells separated by 1px hairlines (top + bottom + verticals between). One cell can be marked .is-accent to tint its number with the secondary CTA accent (typically the headline metric). Collapses to 2×2 at ≤880, 1-col at ≤480.

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width stats section background.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Verticals grid · photo-card catalog
blocks.description: Signature industry catalog. 20 CMS-addressable slots in a responsive photo-card grid. Thirteen cards are visible by default; seven spare slots are hidden until an admin fills the title. Each visible card uses the same media placeholder/photo slot, title, description, URL href, editable status label, and editable CTA label.

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width industries grid background; separate from per-card media slots.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Mobile section · 4 cards with glyphs
blocks.description: Mobile-experience section for hub pages. Centered H2 + 3 ledes + 4 cards, each with a glyph chip, title, and 2 body paragraphs. Light tinted background (--color-gray-bg) so the section sits visually between white sections.

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width mobile section background.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Decorative · callout band (accent-tinted closing strip)
blocks.description: Soft accent-tinted closing band — mono eyebrow + one paragraph at 1.0625rem capped at 76ch reading width. Sits at the bottom of SMB / scale / 'where this leads' sections to summarize the takeaway. Subtle outer accent glow + 1 px accent-tinted border. Light theme.

blocks.title: Decorative · cycle strip (this replaces …)
blocks.description: Small horizontal flow with a label and a series of mono-typed items joined by arrows. Two tones via data-tone: 'warn' (secondary-gradient eyebrow + accent struck-through items, default — used for 'the cycle this replaces' patterns) and 'neutral' (gray eyebrow + plain items — used for positive 'this flows into' patterns). Up to 5 slot items; empty slots auto-hide.

blocks.title: Decorative · final CTA banner
blocks.description: Bottom-of-page CTA section adapted from Section 16 standalone. Dark card surface, mono eyebrow, large closing H2, three-copy rhythm, and canonical ServiceWand primary/secondary CTA pair. Intended as the final conversion section above the footer.

blocks.title: Effect · hover-rise (CTA halo + inner bottom glow)
blocks.description: Brand interaction primitive — standard CTA outer halo plus bottom-centered inner glow that fades in on hover (and on keyboard focus-visible for a11y). No DOM of its own; the effect is applied via CSS pseudo-elements to a set of brand selectors (.btn-primary-ring, .btn-secondary-filled, .nav-link, .nav-trigger, .locale-trigger, .bc-link for the header breadcrumb) and opt-in via [data-fx="rise"] for custom elements. Tinted by --fx-rise-color, defaulting to --cta-accent (which the page's data-theme overlay can re-theme). Uses the same radial contract as cta.btn-primary-ring and cta.btn-secondary-filled: ellipse 58% 78% at 50% 100%, transparent at 60%.
blocks.sourceLabel: example.com .button::after + winter-services .vl-button::after (both inject --button-bg via JS at first hover)

blocks.title: Signature · AI-shell (stream + side panel + capability cards)
blocks.description: Hub-page signature AI section. Three stacked layers: eyebrow + H2 + 2 leads on top; a 2-column 'AI shell' (terminal-style activity stream on the left + media placeholder, H2, and short body copy on the right) in the middle; 3 capability cards (A.NN numbered) at the bottom. Light theme. This is the platform's biggest visual differentiator on the hub landing.

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width signature AI section background; separate from the side-panel media slot.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

blocks.title: Pricing · add-ons
blocks.description: ServiceWand pricing add-ons block for dynamic capacity and usage products such as building packs and routing token expansions. Static slots remain as the CMS/editor fallback.

blocks.title: Pricing · add-ons (bundled rows)
blocks.description: ServiceWand add-ons rendered as horizontal rows grouped by category (Capacity / Usage / Service). Each row exposes a glyph marker, body, quantity meter, price column and Add CTA. Second-opinion variant alongside pricing.addons (which uses a card grid).

blocks.title: Pricing · credits and tokens
blocks.description: Usage/credits surface for routing tokens and other metered consumption. Two side-by-side cards: included monthly allowance per plan with overage rate, and discrete token packs with per-token economics. Distinct from pricing.addons-bundles, which is for capacity packs, not consumable usage.

blocks.title: Pricing · dynamic ServiceWand monoblock
blocks.description: Permanent one-section wrapper for ServiceWand dynamic pricing. It renders plans, token packs, and the comparison matrix from the shared Core PIM pricing runtime while reusing the existing pricing section adapters and styles through dependencies.

blocks.title: Pricing · matrix (collapsible)
blocks.description: ServiceWand plan comparison matrix. Static fallback is driven by column_count and numbered rows; dynamic mode rebuilds columns, groups, rows, and mobile accordions for every plan and visible Core PIM attribute returned by the pricing API.

blocks.title: Pricing · plans (dynamic)
blocks.description: ServiceWand pricing plan grid. Static fallback uses numbered editor slots; dynamic mode clones card markup for every plan returned by Core PIM. Monthly/Annual toggle exposes an inline Save chip on the Annual option and broadcasts a document-level CustomEvent so comparison and credit blocks can sync billing period without coupling.
